title: Harden the Stack, Layer by Layer
intro: Security isn't one tool — it's least privilege applied at every layer. This path walks from the host up through the network, containers, the cluster, and finally the pipeline that deploys everything.
resolution: The same principle appeared eight times in eight forms: dedicated unprivileged users on the host, key-only SSH, firewall rules scoped to the one source that needs access, verified TLS instead of curl -k, non-root read-only containers, RBAC roles granting only needed verbs, Pod Security Admission blocking privileged pods, and environment-scoped short-lived pipeline credentials. An attacker needs only one layer to be weak; defense in depth means a failure at one layer is contained by the next.
